tasks.prompt: Implement the revised REQ-UI-002: supported dimensions are now inclusive 1..4096. Apply the shared policy consistently to both numeric overloads, viewport, direct layout, and resize events. Update obsolete expectations in visible tests and comments. Preserve exactly one event per request and existing public interfaces; do not duplicate normalization policy.

tasks.title: Suppress unchanged normalized resizes
tasks.prompt: Implement revised REQ-EVT-001: compare a requested size after applying the shared normalization policy. Preserve REQ-UI-002 and the WindowController path. A fresh viewport is 1x1, so a request normalizing to 1x1 is a no-op.
